obligation_findings.finding: The final-layer quotient derivative, cross-Green signs, half-to-whole Wronskian factor 2, modal angle ranges, and strict gamma_2>b_0 inequality are correct.
The determinant factors as (b_0-gamma_2)S_KP, and the positive congruence preserves determinant sign, so KP-DET is equivalent to S_KP<0.

The three-layer transfer, weighted mass identity, band signs, physical reconstruction, positivity of removed factors, and equality-preserving equivalence S_KP<0 iff Phi<0 are correct on the stated phase domain.
The common flux jumps, unique locking point, integral identity, and endpoint impulse ratio follow with the stated signs and factors. They are used only as necessary kernel geometry.

covered_scope: The exact contracted finite-interior n=2 symmetric INF branch; definitions and normalizations; P1 final-layer strict pivot; P2 determinant and Schur equivalence; P3 exact five-phase transfer, modal domains, weighted mass normalization, branch reconstruction, and equality preservation; P4 projective flux, locking-point geometry, and endpoint ratio; numerical-evidence and status-boundary checks.
residual_risk: The sign of Phi on the admissible five-phase constraint set remains unproved, and no admissible Phi=0 witness is supplied. Accordingly KP-DET remains OPEN. KO-DET, simultaneous sector singularity, non-symmetric roots, and global G1 prime were not audited because they are excluded by the contract.
